module johnson_counter4 (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output [3:0] q
);

reg [3:0] current_state, next_state;

// Next state logic (combinational)
always @(*) begin
    case (current_state)
        4'b0000: next_state = 4'b0001; // S0 → S1
        4'b0001: next_state = 4'b0010; // S1 → S2
        4'b0010: next_state = 4'b0100; // S2 → S3
        4'b0100: next_state = 4'b1000; // S3 → S4
        4'b1000: next_state = 4'b0001; // S4 → S1 (cycle repeats)
        default: next_state = 4'b0001; // Handle unexpected states
    endcase
end

// State register (sequential)
always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        current_state <= 4'b0000; // Reset to S0
    end else begin
        current_state <= next_state; // Update to next state
    end
end

// Output assignment
assign q = current_state;

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input cpu_overheated,
  output reg shut_off_computer,
  input arrived,
  input gas_tank_empty,
  output reg keep_driving
);

  reg state; // 0: IDLE, 1: RUN
  reg reason; // 0: CPU_OVERHEATED, 1: NO_MONEY

  reg next_state;
  reg next_reason;

  // Combinational next state and reason logic
  always @(*) begin
    next_state = state;
    next_reason = reason;
    if (arrived) begin
      next_state = 1'b0; // IDLE
    end else if (state == 1'b0) begin // IDLE state
      if (!gas_tank_empty) begin // Check money first
        next_state = 1'b1; // RUN
        next_reason = 1'b0; // CPU_OVERHEATED (placeholder)
      end else begin
        next_state = 1'b0; // Stay IDLE
        next_reason = 1'b1; // NO_MONEY
      end
    end else begin // RUN state
      if (cpu_overheated) begin
        next_state = 1'b0; // IDLE
        next_reason = 1'b0; // CPU_OVERHEATED
      end else if (!arrived) begin
        next_state = 1'b0; // IDLE (external trigger)
        next_reason = 1'b1; // NO_MONEY (placeholder)
      end else begin
        next_state = 1'b1; // Stay RUN
        next_reason = 1'b0; // CPU_OVERHEATED
      end
    end
  end

  // Sequential state and reason update
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
      state <= 1'b0;
      reason <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      state <= next_state;
      reason <= next_reason;
    end
  end

  // Output logic
  always @(*) begin
    shut_off_computer = (state == 1'b1) && cpu_overheated;
    keep_driving = (state == 1'b1) && !cpu_overheated && !arrived;
  end

endmodule

module synchronizer(
	input 				clk_a	, 
	input 				clk_b	,   
	input 				arstn	,
	input				brstn   ,
	input		[3:0]	data_in	,
	input               data_en ,

	output reg  [3:0] 	dataout
);

    // Synchronize data_en to clk_b domain
    reg [1:0] sync_sel_b;
    always @(posedge clk_b or negedge brstn) begin
        if (!brstn) begin
            sync_sel_b <= 2'b00;
        end else begin
            sync_sel_b <= {sync_sel_b[0], data_en};
        end
    end

    // Synchronize data_in to clk_b domain
    reg [3:0] sync_data_in_b;
    always @(posedge clk_b or negedge brstn) begin
        if (!brstn) begin
            sync_data_in_b <= 4'b0;
        end else begin
            sync_data_in_b <= data_in;
        end
    end

    // Update dataout on clk_b edge
    always @(posedge clk_b or negedge brstn) begin
        if (!brstn) begin
            dataout <= 4'b0;
        end else begin
            case (sync_sel_b)
                2'b00: dataout <= 4'b0;          // Idle state
                2'b01: dataout <= sync_data_in_b;// Capture synchronized data
                2'b10: dataout <= dataout;       // Hold state
                2'b11: dataout <= 4'bx;          // Undefined state
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
